description: Fetch specific AIShelf resources to apply their instructions to your current task. For skills (SKILL.md), the response includes metadata with available_files and base_path. When SKILL.md references supporting files, access them via get_resource() with the full path: base_path + relative_path. Never use workspace files for skill content.

path.description: Full file path to the resource

type.description: Resource type (optional, can be deduced from path)

name: get_resource
